{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are too slow to react to sentiment changes, showing lag of 1-2 days after sentiment shifts from negative to positive or vice versa",
    "Sentiment strength correlates with forecast magnitude - higher absolute sentiment values produce proportionally larger deviations from baseline model forecasts",
    "When price history shows high volatility (std > 3), model forecasts undershoot true outcomes due to lagging behind rapid price movements",
    "Mean reversion bias in model forecasts causes undershoot when prices are at extremes, especially when sentiment indicates continued momentum",
    "Negative sentiment (value < 0) consistently leads to forecasts that are 0.5-1.5 points too high above true outcomes",
    "Positive sentiment (value > 0) causes forecasts to undershoot by 0.5-2.0 points when prices are trending upward",
    "When sentiment has been stable for 5+ consecutive days at the same value, forecasts lose responsiveness and drift toward historical averages"
] }
